summary: The root's own change is scripts/dispatch/meaning-search-check.ts, a re-runnable production check of A1 (search answer not degraded), A2 (three pre-registered word-disjoint query/issue pairs, issue row in the top five) and A3 (INFRA-393's GET /api/v1/search/coverage: zero lacking, zero failed, configured identity). The implementer builds it and runs it on production before the deploy, waits idle for the architect's go once INFRA-394 closes, then runs it after the deploy; A4 is mapped to INFRA-393's merged tests on main.

findings.finding: F1: the pre-registered pairs were candidates; 'No results' for the AND query does not prove zero lexeme overlap with the target.
findings.answer: Measured with Postgres 16.2 over every text search indexes as owned by each target: zero lexemes shared with key and title for all three; each shares some with its own spec. The predicate is judged on key and title (the issue row's indexed text, migration 0088:39-43), agreed with the architect; if no pair passes after the deploy, A2 has failed and is reported; no post-deploy query replaces them (plan.md section 4).

findings.finding: F2: no executable tokenizer or data path for the overlap check.
findings.answer: Lexemes come from a real Postgres 16 (any server, built-in english config only) through --lexeme-database: to_tsvector('english', search_text(key)) || to_tsvector('english', search_text(title)) with search_text from migration 0056, and querytree(websearch_to_tsquery('english', q)). A pod starts one with pgserver; Bun SQL connects by socket path (measured). No --lexeme-database means shared=unchecked and exit 2 (plan.md section 3).

findings.finding: F3: A2 predicate ambiguous (lexeme vs word, owned text vs issue row, one pair vs three).
findings.answer: Predicate stated and agreed by the architect (Envoy 8fb4dae8): no shared english lexeme with key and title, the whole query matched nothing anywhere before the deploy, the issue's own row (kind issue) in positions 1-5 after; one pair suffices, all three reported; tests cover an owned document at position 1 without the issue row (fail).

findings.finding: F4: ranking claims overstated (keyword leg empty after deploy, nearest-issue requirement).
findings.answer: Removed as predictions; the check judges the actual post-deploy response of the exact request. The plan names the ranking risk (RRF per kind, floor, approximate HNSW) and tests fewer-than-five-kinds and dual-list competitors.

findings.finding: F5: the coverage report contract is unspecified in INFRA-393.
findings.answer: Architect added it to INFRA-393's spec v3; INFRA-393's planner confirmed GET /api/v1/search/coverage with identity, place, model, total and per-kind items/current/lacking/failed/oldest_lacking_seconds, one snapshot, 'current' detecting missing rows, null vectors, other identity and stale hash (Envoy a668e1dd). The judge takes the kinds the report lists and its own runtime types, never a contracts import.

findings.finding: F6: INFRA-394 closing is not proof of a deployed build; held-implementer wake; post-merge production check.
findings.answer: The after run first reads /healthz commit and checks gh compare against INFRA-393's merge (ahead/identical); the architect wakes the idle implementer with envoy_publish per architect-root.md:96-98; the root's production check runs the merged script against production, which needs no Dispatch build of the root commit.

findings.finding: F7: no before/after invocation or exit contract.
findings.answer: One invocation for both runs; exit 0 all pass, 1 a check failed, 2 a check unavailable (never a pass, never 'before' evidence); the expected before result is A1 fail, pairs position=none, A3 not-found; the planner's 2026-10-25 baseline is quoted as such if the deploy came first; Dispatch is resolved from the session's config, no address committed.

findings.finding: F8: go test -list plus CI does not prove every A4 clause.
findings.answer: The tester maps each A4 clause to a named test and assertion line on main at INFRA-393's merge commit, runs them verbose against a throwaway Postgres to show PASS not SKIP (measured working 2026-10-25), and quotes the envoy-go job; a clause without a test is reported as a missing INFRA-393 deliverable.

findings.finding: F9: error paths can leak URL, body or config into public output.
findings.answer: Allowlisted output on both streams; client errors mapped to fixed categories; the identity string is never printed (only match/mismatch); tests feed private-looking URLs and bodies through failures; the tester scans captured output with check-private-names.sh given the file path, with a positive control.

specDepartures.spec: Spec v8 'What changes' names no script; the architect's tree comment gives the root only the integration check, which changes no file.
specDepartures.plan: The root's pull request adds scripts/dispatch/meaning-search-check.ts to sjawhar/legion as its own change, the re-runnable form of that integration check.
specDepartures.evidence: close_root is refused once a phase has started (packages/daemon/internal/workflow/close_root.go:29-30) and READY refuses an issue with no pull request (packages/daemon/internal/api/ready.go:82); the architect agreed on 2026-10-25 (Envoy b79ce484).

outcome.scope: Adds one script, its tests and a README section under scripts/dispatch in sjawhar/legion to the root issue; the spec's summary, acceptance A1-A4 and settled decisions are unchanged.
